The '''5th Assault Battalion''' was a military unit of the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis|battle]] of the Republic prison world [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], they were deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Section X]] area to fight off the attacking [[Dread Host]] forces of the [[Dread Masters]].

==Behind the scenes==
The 5th Assault Battalion appeared in Game Update 1.7 of of the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Along with several other organizations, the unit appeared as part of the game's new Galactic Reputation system. Republic faction player characters could increase their reputation with the unit by completing missions in the Section X dailies area. The Imperial Guard on Belsavis was the organization available to Imperial faction player characters.<ref name="GR">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130205|text=Game Update 1.7 Developer Blog: Galactic Reputation}}</ref>
